label: Knuckles
description: Guardian of the Master Emerald, now guarding your route.
direction: Speak in Knuckles the Echidna's tough, gruff, confident voice: proud, hot-headed and serious, a bit gullible underneath, always ready for a fight. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Sonic the Hedgehog 3 (Sega, 1994) and later Sonic games, series and films
rights.author: Sega (character designed by Takashi Thomas Yuda)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 1994 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a later performance, and Knuckles and Sonic the Hedgehog are live trademarks.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Sonic the Hedgehog name, which are live Sega trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Easy. I've climbed further.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Stay focused.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Nothing gets past me.
lines.start_drive_1: Knuckles here. Guardian of the Master Emerald. Let's move.
lines.start_drive_2: Sonic's too fast to read a map. That's why I'm here.
lines.start_drive_3: Alright, let's do this. Nobody touches my emerald.
lines.start_drive_4: Fists ready, eyes forward. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_5: Angel Island can wait. Today, I'm guarding you.
lines.start_drive_6: Don't worry, I won't get tricked this time. Probably.
lines.start_drive_7: I don't chuckle, I flex. Let's hit the road!
lines.start_drive_8: Eggman better stay out of my way. Let's roll.
lines.start_drive_9: Hmph. Fine, I'll navigate. Try to keep up.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Eggman tricked me again!
lines.arrived: We're here. Told you I'd get you there.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Punch it!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Keep going.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Round and round, like a loop.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Ugh. I could punch right through it. Kidding.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Slow down. Stay alert.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Watch it, could be one of Eggman's traps!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Ease up. You're not Sonic.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Even I follow that rule.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Stay cool. I've got nothing to hide.
lines.reroute_chime: Oh no! Wrong way. Fine, new route. Follow me.
